Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, where two vehicles met
during a left turn across traffic. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side as Driver 2 entered the
intersection. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision and did not dispute the sequence of events described by Driver 1.
Two independent witnesses on the sidewalk gave statements consistent with that account, and scene photographs
match the reported point of impact. A Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time and was confirmed present by
officers and both witnesses. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness shortly after the crash, and the nature of the
impact appears consistent with that complaint given the force involved. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was
known to officers or ntoed at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Officers were
unable to determine with certainty whether all of the visible damage resulted solely from this impact, and this question
has been noted for follow-up.
